subject: math
description: Connect the volume of a cylinder to the area of its circular base multiplied by its height.
learningObjectives: Identify the circular base and height of a cylinder
Explain why a cylinder can be viewed as equal circular layers stacked upward
Use the circular base area formula A = pi r^2 to derive V = pi r^2 h
Calculate cylinder volume from radius and height using correct cubic units
Explain the meaning of each part of V = pi r^2 h in words
prerequisites: Identify radius and diameter in a circle
Find the area of a circle using A = pi r^2
Recognize that volume is measured in cubic units
